description: Source code for a documentation processing module, defining classes and functions for handling documentation structures, linking, and code group processing.

classes.name: Documentation
classes.description: Main class managing a collection of documentation classes, handling linking, filtering, and code comment generation.

classes.name: Class
classes.description: Represents a documented class with members, properties, methods, and inheritance handling.

classes.name: Member
classes.description: Represents a class member such as method, property, or event, with filtering and cloning capabilities.

classes.name: Type
classes.description: Represents a data type with parsing, cloning, and filtering functionalities.

methods.name: mergeWith
methods.description: Merges current documentation with another, combining class definitions.

methods.name: copyDocsFromSuperclasses
methods.description: Copies documentation from superclasses, checking for overrides and undefined superclasses.

methods.name: filterForLanguage
methods.description: Filters classes and members based on target programming language.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Indexes classes and their members for quick lookup.

methods.name: setLinkRenderer
methods.description: Sets a custom link rendering function and patches links in documentation nodes.

methods.name: renderLinksInNodes
methods.description: Replaces link placeholders in documentation nodes with actual links.

methods.name: renderLinksInText
methods.description: Replaces link placeholders in text with actual links.

methods.name: setCodeGroupsTransformer
methods.description: Sets a transformer for code group processing based on language.

methods.name: generateSourceCodeComments
methods.description: Generates source code comments for all classes and members.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the documentation object.
